Boston Dynamics Appoints Rohit Prasad as New CEO

Boston Dynamics, a humanoid robot maker owned by Hyundai Motor Group, has appointed Rohit Prasad as its new chief executive officer, effective October 7. Prasad, formerly a senior vice president and head scientist for Alexa and Artificial General Intelligence at Amazon, brings 12 years of experience from his tenure at Amazon, where he contributed to building and expanding Alexa. He also has prior experience in machine-learning research at Raytheon.
